Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27

Two Districts • Two Countries • One Rotary Family 🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, India | Rotary District 4895, Argentina
1–10 October 2026

A Journey of Friendship, Discovery and Lasting Memories!

The Rotary Friendship Exchange (RFE) 2026–27 was a truly once-in-a-lifetime experience for our delegation of 10 Rotarians, hosted by the wonderful Rotarians of District 4895, Argentina.

From warm welcomes to unforgettable fellowship, every moment reflected the true spirit of Rotary. We had the privilege of meeting District Governor Rtn. Gustavo J. Tondi,

District Governor Elect Monica,

Past district leaders,

India's Ambassador to Argentina Shri Ajaneesh Kumar, and

Mr. John Alviro Martínez, Mayor of América, Argentina.

We experienced Argentina's vibrant culture through traditional tango, local cuisine, farmhouse hospitality, and meaningful cultural exchanges.

*Flag exchanges with 8 Clubs,

*Sister club agreement with RC of Villa del parque,

community interactions, and discussions on service projects opened exciting possibilities for future collaboration.

This exchange has strengthened the bond between District 3141 and District 4895, creating opportunities for future service partnerships, professional connections, and international goodwill.

Ten Days • Countless Memories • Friendships for a Lifetime
